limitations.en: The source grid is 3 arc-seconds (approximately 100 m at the equator), and the current R2025A product is an alpha release that WorldPop says may be revised as methods improve. Years after the current calendar year are modeled projections, not observations; zero or nodata means no population was allocated to that grid cell, not that the location is confirmed uninhabited. Files are keyed by country, so an area of interest given only as a box cannot be served: name the countries. WorldPop assigns every cell to exactly one country, so adjacent country files do not double count along borders.

description.en: Annual constrained, UN-adjusted WorldPop population counts at approximately 100 m, one snapshot per year from the newest release. With an area of interest naming countries, their files are mosaicked and clipped to the area, every published year included. Without an area of interest the whole world is ingested: each country's file becomes one source of the year's snapshot, and only the current year is taken by default, since a global year is about 10 GB of source and 3.5 GB stored. params.years ("all", or a list) widens or narrows the years, params.countries overrides the area.
Annual WorldPop constrained estimates of people per approximately 100 m grid cell for the deployment area of interest.
description.fr: Estimations annuelles contraintes de WorldPop du nombre de personnes par cellule de grille d’environ 100 m pour la zone de déploiement ciblée.
description.pt: Estimativas anuais restritas do WorldPop do número de pessoas por célula de grade de aproximadamente 100 m para a área de interesse da implantação.
description.es: Estimaciones anuales restringidas de WorldPop del número de personas por celda de cuadrícula de aproximadamente 100 m para el área de interés del despliegue.
description.mg: Tombana voafetra isan-taona avy amin’ny WorldPop momba ny isan’ny olona isaky ny sela harato manodidina ny 100 m ho an’ny faritra kendrena amin’ny fametrahana.
